fusions.name: Torn-Off Tail
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Tears off a slip of yourself and flings it into the first enemy it meets, which deals 9 damage.

fusions.name: Stilling Page
fusions.desc: Holds up a cold page that chills a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, stunning each target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Pages
fusions.desc: Sheds your outer pages: removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Basking Folio
fusions.desc: In daylight, you deal 12% more damage.
